title: Use the exact same prompt and a fixed 30-second sequence to run a direct…
content: Use the exact same prompt and a fixed 30-second sequence to run a direct side-by-side comparison between Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 in CapCut, evaluating vehicle physics, camera stability, motion blur, character consistency, dialogue, and cinematic realism without changing any prompt settings.
tips: Use the exact same prompt and a fixed 30-second sequence to run a direct side-by-side comparison between Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 in CapCut, evaluating vehicle physics, camera stability, motion blur, character consistency, dialogue, and cinematic realism without changing any prompt settings.

es.content: Usa exactamente el mismo prompt y una secuencia fija de 30 segundos para realizar una comparación directa lado a lado entre Seedance 2.0 y Seedance 2.5 en CapCut, evaluando la física del vehículo, la estabilidad de la cámara, el motion blur, la consistencia del personaje, el diálogo y el realismo cinematográfico sin cambiar ninguna configuración del prompt.

fr.content: Utilisez exactement le même prompt et une séquence fixe de 30 secondes pour effectuer une comparaison directe côte à côte entre Seedance 2.0 et Seedance 2.5 dans CapCut, en évaluant la physique du véhicule, la stabilité de la caméra, le motion blur, la cohérence des personnages, les dialogues et le réalisme cinématographique, sans modifier aucun paramètre du prompt.

ja.content: CapCutでSeedance 2.0とSeedance 2.5を直接並べて比較するために、まったく同じpromptと固定の30秒シーケンスを使用し、vehicle physics、camera stability、motion blur、character consistency、dialogue、そしてcinematic realismを、いかなるprompt設定も変更せずに評価してください。

ko.content: CapCut에서 Seedance 2.0과 Seedance 2.5를 직접 나란히 비교하기 위해 동일한 prompt와 고정된 30초 시퀀스를 사용하여, 어떤 prompt 설정도 변경하지 않은 상태에서 차량 물리, 카메라 안정성, 모션 블러, 캐릭터 일관성, 대사, 그리고 cinematic realism을 평가하세요.

pt.content: Use o mesmo prompt exato e uma sequência fixa de 30 segundos para executar uma comparação direta lado a lado entre o Seedance 2.0 e o Seedance 2.5 no CapCut, avaliando física do veículo, estabilidade da câmera, motion blur, consistência dos personagens, diálogo e realismo cinematográfico, sem alterar nenhuma configuração do prompt.

zh.content: 使用完全相同的 prompt 和固定的 30 秒序列，在 CapCut 中直接进行并排对比，比较 Seedance 2.0 和 Seedance 2.5 在车辆物理、镜头稳定性、运动模糊、角色一致性、对白以及 cinematic realism 方面的表现，且不更改任何 prompt 设置。
